title: Fix ReportView crash causing CI test failures
body:
`ReportView` crashes with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'title')` due to a state sync race condition and a field name mismatch between `@objectstack/spec` (`label`) and `@object-ui/types` (`title`). ### Race condition fix `initialReport` (derived from `useMetadata()`) becomes defined one render cycle before `reportData` (synced via `useEffect`). The guard checked `!initialReport` but the render path accessed `reportData`, which was still `undefined`. ```tsx // Before: crashes when initialReport is found but reportData hasn't synced yet if (!initialReport) { ... } // ...

{reportData.title}

// 💥 reportData is undefined // After: guard covers both variables if (!initialReport || !reportData) { if (!loading && !initialReport) return ; return ; // brief spinner while effect syncs } ``` ### `label` → `title` mapping `@objectstack/spec` defines reports with `label` (required), but `ReportViewer` renders `report.title`. Added mapping at the boundary: ```tsx const reportForViewer = reportData.title ? reportData : { ...reportData, title: reportData.label }; ``` Display text also falls back: `reportData.title || reportData.label || 'Report Viewer'` ### Test adjustment Changed `getByText` → `getAllByText` since the title now correctly renders in both the page header (`h1`) and the `ReportViewer` toolbar (`h2`).
Original prompt > fix ci build and test
